name: caption-first-panini
description: Round 4 — a rich English caption with FILLING/Seasonings/DOUGH sections must be parsed in full: ranges (1/2-1 cup), comma-separated seasoning lists, water and baking powder all survive; the headline does not leak as a phantom ingredient.

input.socialCaption:
Homemade cheesy beef panini pockets

FILLING:
500g minced beef
1 small onion, diced
1/2 red bell pepper
1/2 yellow bell pepper
2 garlic cloves, minced
2 tbsp tomato paste
1/4 cup water
2 cups mozzarella

Seasonings:
Salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, oregano, cayenne, thyme & all-purpose seasoning

DOUGH:
3 cups all purpose Flour
1 tbsp Baking powder
1 tsp Salt
1 tbsp Sugar
1/2-1 cup Milk
2 tbsp oil or melted butter
